newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-DUTCH RECALL OVERMARS FOR WORLD CUP TIE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUTCH RECALL OVERMARS FOR WORLD CUP TIE.

text.p: Winger Marc Overmars has been recalled to the Dutch squad for Saturday's World Cup group seven qualifier against Wales in Eindhoven.
The Ajax Amsterdam player, who had a knee operation last winter, last played for the Netherlands in December 1995 in the 2-0 win over Ireland that booked the Dutch a place at Euro96.
Coach Guus Hiddink has had to make three changes from the squad that won 3-1 in Wales last month, with Ajax's versatile Winston Bogarde, PSV Eindhoven's Stan Valckx and Jordi Cruyff all unfit.
Hiddink has found replacements in England, Germany and Italy, bringing back Arsenal's Dennis Bergkamp, Johan de Kock from Germany's Schalke '04 and AC Milan's Michael Reiziger.

Celtic's troubled striker Pierre van Hooijdonk, who came on as a late substitute in Cardiff to score two goals, and Vitesse Arnhem's Roy Makaay are retained, but there is no place for four Ajax stars -- Patrick Kluivert, Peter Hoekstra, Richard Witschge and John Veldman -- who are only just returning at club level after injury.
Goalkeepers - Edwin van der Sar (Ajax), Ed de Goey (Feyenoord)
Defenders - Frank de Boer (Ajax), Arthur Numan, Jaap Stam (both PSV), Ferdy Vierklau (Vitesse), Andre Ooyer (Roda JC), Michael Reiziger (AC Milan), Johan De Kock (Schalke).
Midfielders - Ronald de Boer (Ajax), Aron Winter (Inter Milan), Clarence Seedorf (Real Madrid), Philip Cocu, Wim Jonk (both PSV), Giovanni van Bronkhorst (Feyenoord)
Strikers - Youri Mulder (Schalke), Dennis Bergkamp (Arsenal), Pierre van Hooijdonk (Celtic), Marc Overmars (Ajax), Roy Makaay (Vitesse)
